Name: Magica Trees for Alternative Textures (Oak maple and mushroom only)
Author: PlumeQoQ
Description:
Provides more textures for the magic tree. Please note that only oak and maple have seasonal changes, mushroom trees have no seasonal changes, and there is no texture of pine  and palm (because I personally don't like it). Please use a paint bucket to change the texture.

为Magica Trees提供了更多的纹理。要注意的是只有橡树和枫树具有季节性变化，有蘑菇树但无季节性变化，没有松树和棕榈树的纹理
(原因是我个人不喜欢）。请使用油漆桶改变纹理。
